segments_b.text: This is the library. Nothing here is dead. The shelves breathe, and the books choose their readers.
The lion keeps the door. He was here before you arrived. He belongs the way the walls belong.
The owl brings the book of life. Its cover carries the tree, the mark of everything we keep.
Watch! No hands. The book opens itself.
In a living library, the book wants to be read.
The bee takes his proud little place on the open page.
The dragon browses, chooses and carries.
Every intelligence in this house tens the shelves.
The library has been waiting for you.
